evidence_quote: double-blind randomized controlled trial in 124 adults (aged 18-65) with chronic insomnia
rationale: 双盲 RCT，成人慢性失眠，NX-3 对比安慰剂，主结局为入睡潜伏期：四条纳入标准全部满足。
人群为 6-12 岁儿童，违反 I2（≥18 岁成人）。
入组年龄 16 起，可能包含未成年人；是否违反 I2 需集中裁定。

evidence_quote: randomly assigned 240 adults with chronic insomnia to NX-3 or matching placebo
rationale: 多中心 RCT，成人慢性失眠，NX-3 对比匹配安慰剂，主结局 sleep onset latency。

evidence_quote: randomized controlled trial, 96 older adults (aged 60-80) with chronic insomnia received NX-3 or placebo
rationale: 老年成人 RCT，NX-3 对比安慰剂，结局含 sleep latency。
对照为唑吡坦且明确无安慰剂组，违反 I3。

evidence_quote: allocated to NX-3 or placebo by alternation
rationale: 交替分配是否算 RCT 需集中裁定。

evidence_quote: randomized controlled trial of NX-3 versus placebo
rationale: 成人慢性失眠且基线睡眠潜伏期 >30 分钟，NX-3 对比安慰剂 RCT，主终点 sleep latency。

evidence_quote: Sleep onset latency was recorded as an exploratory secondary outcome
rationale: 入睡潜伏期仅为探索性次要结局，是否满足 I4 的“必须包含”需集中裁定。

evidence_quote: 110 adults with chronic insomnia took NX-3 or placebo at bedtime
rationale: 睡前给药 RCT，成人慢性失眠，NX-3 对比安慰剂，主结局 sleep latency。
